acceptance: Each listed project that has bumped its catalog pin past the removal no longer lists tidy-perms, and its skill-sync check passes.
Projects that have not bumped are listed as still pending.
context: Cross-repository; each edit follows that repository's own change process. Not part of the skillspector-remediation batch.
description: The catalog no longer ships tidy-perms. BenchBox, Oxbow, tractable and skill-sync list `skill = tidy-perms` in skill-sync.conf; letterops-mcp and textcharts list it in older skill-sync.yaml manifests. Each keeps working at its pinned rev and fails to sync only when it pins a rev that includes the removal. The owner deferred these edits (2026-11-13) to each project's next pin bump.
